about: Pre-registered analysis settings of R1: comparison families (Holm), TOST margin, tolerance tiers, stratification cut points and the other choices the analysis scripts under analysis/r1/ read. Format by E20a; the pending values are decided in 1D, before any test run, and the file is frozen with the other pre-registration items (configs/freeze_spec.json, item prereg_analysis).

Every entry of `items` has a status: fixed = decided, `value` is used and `basis` names the decision; pending = not decided yet, `value` is null. An analysis of test data refuses a pending item. A dev analysis may run on the item's `proposal` (when there is one) and then lists the item under `pending_used` in its output.

Configuration labels: a repairing configuration is named <config>@<k> for the ladder point 'at most k repair rounds' (C3L@2, C3L@1, C3E@2), a configuration without repair by its id (C0, C1, C2). Scopes: a benchmark name or 'pooled' (both benchmarks, bootstrap resampled within benchmark).

Outcomes: correct (primary tier), correct_tol:<tier>, correct_original_ref, verified_correct, exec_ok. An analysis set whose reference kind is 'original' (sens_orig_ref) scores with the original reference values automatically.

primary_comparison.basis: DECISIONS R1-D5 (main comparison C3L vs C3E; main model qwen3:8b; at most 2 repair rounds is the primary reading)

outcome_primary.basis: R1-D5 default 3 and R1-D13: printed FINAL_OBJECTIVE, |obj - ref| <= max(t, t*|ref|) at t = 1e-4, IEEE 754 double precision (R1-D16 item 2)

tolerance_tiers.basis: R1-D13 (runtime/orgene/score.py TOLERANCES; keys of correct_tol in the result rows)

analysis_set_main.basis: R1-D6 and R1-D16 item 4: MAMO cleaned subset and IndustryOR 2026 revision, both *_excl0905, minus NL_NOT_LINEARIZABLE and Q3-removed cases

analysis_sets_sensitivity.basis: R1-D6 (the *_incl0905 sets are the only results that include the 9 cases viewed on 2026-09-05)

analysis_set_dev_signal.basis: R1-D5 and R1-D6 (dev correctness signal: 55 cleaned dev cases)

repeats.value: per-case mean over repeats before resampling and testing; the case is the resampling unit, never the call

paired_test.value: exact two-sided McNemar on the per-case outcomes (exact sign test on per-case mean differences when a case has several repeats)
paired_test.basis: engineering plan 3.20; stage-0 report T8 section 2.2

alpha.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)

bootstrap.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)

holm_families.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)
holm_families.note: The primary family is the single comparison H1. 'Per-problem vs all activation' (C3L vs C3L-ALL) left the controls family on 2026-10-03: activation does not change the C3L trigger sets (offline replay), so it is reported descriptively. Mechanism comparisons are not in any family; H2 is a gated test. The agent baseline ORA (E15) is not run (author decision 2026-10-03): C3L vs ORA left the controls family; the generate-execute-debug comparison is C3E, with C3A and C0R-E as further controls.

tost_margin.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)
tost_margin.note: Reported as 'any effect is smaller than 5 points', never as no effect (prereg draft section 4).

value.method: Tango score interval for the paired difference (primary); case bootstrap percentile interval (cross-check)

tost.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)
tost.note: The equivalence reading of the primary comparison applies only when H1 is not rejected.

value.primary: conditional logistic regression, one stratum per case
value.sensitivity: GEE, binomial family, exchangeable working correlation, clusters = cases
value.quartiles: output-token quartiles pooled over the compared configurations (statistics.quantiles n=4, inclusive); accuracy per configuration and quartile
value.out_tokens: sum over all calls of the unit, as the result rows record it

strata_scale_feature.basis: 1D, author decision 2026-10-04: the numbers written in the statement (data volume); it does not depend on model output, unlike n_variables_est and n_constraints_est, which are missing where the C0 program fails

strata_scale_cutpoints.basis: 1D, 2026-10-04: tertile cut points per benchmark from the frozen dev cases, as data/features/scale_features.json records them (analysis/r1/scale_features.py)

strata_industryor_difficulty.basis: IndustryOR case records (field of the pinned release); only the label is read

strata_type_labels.basis: R1-D6 (adjudicated type labels, ingested by data/ingest_annotations.py)

value.n: main analysis set, per benchmark and pooled

shared_round0_mde.basis: stage-0 report T8 section 3.4 (method unchanged); author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)

value: heuristic-only cases set to generic repair
forest_settings.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)
forest_settings.note: 'API model' replaced by the second open-weight model (decision 2026-09-29); 'activation all' removed (reported descriptively); the conservative bound of mechanism.py added.

gated_tests.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)
gated_tests.note: Fixed sequence: H2 (gene diagnosis and prescription beyond detection with an equal-length generic checklist, 1-round cut: same trigger, same number of calls) is tested only if H1 is rejected; familywise error stays at 0.05. Otherwise it is reported as an estimate.

estimates: nested decomposition d(L-E) = d(T-E) + d(L-T), pooled and per round-0 stratum N/P/X/M
detection, repair success, false alarm and break rates per label
gains by function class of the applied genes
conservative bound for the answer-distribution heuristic
C3L@2 vs C0R-E@2 (rules in the prompt), with calls and tokens
second model: C3L@2 vs C3E@2 on gpt-oss:20b, reported outside every family

mechanism.basis: author decision 2026-10-03 (D12; prereg draft v2, stage1/prereg/PREREG_DRAFT_EN.md)
mechanism.note: Estimates and descriptions only (analysis/r1/mechanism.py --from-prereg); none enters a Holm family.
